hero.title: Humans and agents need one governed place to work.
hero.lead: AI now investigates, recommends, and acts. GIK gives mixed teams one evolving operational state without erasing identity, authority, or accountability.

invariants.title: Many actors
invariants.text: Humans and agents contribute through one participation model while retaining distinct roles.

invariants.title: One state
invariants.text: Every surface projects the same evolving operational truth.

invariants.title: Governed action
invariants.text: Role and policy decide what may be proposed, authorized, or executed.

invariants.title: Complete provenance
invariants.text: Every contribution and consequence remains attributable.

fractures.title: Human interface
fractures.text: Operators see a partial view of the work, often disconnected from agent context.

fractures.title: Agent runtime
fractures.text: Agents reason and act through separate state and authority paths.

fractures.title: Retrospective logs
fractures.text: Accountability is reconstructed after the fact instead of governing the action itself.

socActs.title: Morgan establishes investigation intent
socActs.text: Morgan commits the investigation goal to shared state.

socActs.title: Priya protects the payroll cutover
socActs.text: Priya adds the protected DC-01 operating constraint.

socActs.title: Morgan narrows the exploration
socActs.text: Morgan amends its window, method, and safety scope.

socActs.title: Correlation Agent replans
socActs.text: Correlation accepts the amended passive exploration.

socActs.title: Correlation Agent commits partial findings
socActs.text: Correlation contributes attributed but incomplete evidence.

socActs.title: Response Agent proposes DC-01 isolation
socActs.text: Policy rejects the unsafe target and applies a fallback.

socActs.title: Correlation Agent resolves the origin
socActs.text: Evidence resolves Host-A as the execution origin.

socActs.title: Morgan revises the response
socActs.text: Morgan requires preservation and dependency verification.

socActs.title: Morgan recommends containment
socActs.text: Morgan recommends without exceeding analyst authority.

socActs.title: Response Agent executes containment
socActs.text: Response executes only after a separate presenter advance.

causalChain.text: Morgan redirects the method while preserving the original revision.
Policy blocks DC-01 isolation and preserves useful work safely.
Morgan recommends the revised Host-A plan without exceeding analyst authority.
Priya supplies the required Incident Commander authority.
Response Agent isolates Host-A and records the outcome.

trustProof.title: One operational truth
trustProof.text: Participant panels, workspace, journal, and projections derive from the same revisioned substrate.

trustProof.title: Authority stays explicit
trustProof.text: Humans and agents share a participation path, but role and policy constrain both.

trustProof.title: Governance changes outcomes
trustProof.text: Unsafe work is rejected or redirected through fallback rather than merely logged.

trustProof.title: Causality is reconstructable
trustProof.text: Suggestion, amendment, evidence, recommendation, authorization, and execution remain distinct.

proofPlanes.label: Runtime · HX + AX
proofPlanes.title: Experience the SOC Runtime
proofPlanes.text: Watch two humans and two agents change one shared incident state through attributable, role-bounded actions.

proofPlanes.label: Blueprint · DX + ACX
proofPlanes.title: Inspect the Executable Blueprint
proofPlanes.text: Trace the same SOC intent through four tiers and three lowering recipes into the runtime document.

expansion.title: The invariant travels beyond one domain and one screen.

domains.label: SOC · Protect
domains.text: Correlate evidence, reject unsafe containment, and require commander authority.

domains.label: Tax Prep · Optimize + comply
domains.text: Synthesize source documents, invalidate unsupported optimizations under current policy, recompute, and confirm before filing.

taxJourney: Documents establish an initial tax position
An agent proposes an optimization with source and policy citations
A policy change invalidates part of the strategy
The kernel recomputes while the agent replans
Filing remains blocked behind human confirmation
expansion.boundary: Beat 4 proves remote, transported, and headless continuity. The current SOC runtime proves deterministic in-process collaboration; it does not prove durable remote clients or background agents.
